title: Mini Build: About Me Page
prompt:
Build your first complete personal page — everything from this module in one small build.

Requirements:
- Full skeleton: doctype, `html lang`, `head` with charset and a `title` of `About Me`.
- One `h1` with your name.
- Two paragraphs about you.
- A `ul` with three `li` items: things you want to build one day.

tests.name: skeleton with charset and title
tests.hint: Same skeleton as before — but the <title> text must be exactly 'About Me'.

tests.name: name heading and two paragraphs
tests.hint:
Your Name

then two

elements introducing yourself.

tests.name: a wish list unordered list
tests.hint: <ul> with three <li> children — things you want to build one day.
